page.layout: One page of text: a title block at the top, then a list of monastery names, one entry per line, followed by a catchword at the lower right.

main_text.head: SVBIICIO HIC NOMINA Cœ-NOBIORVM, QVÆ IN HAC PRO-vincia sunt aut fuêre, ut ea in libro vetusto scripta inveni.
main_text.l: Menterna, cui post nomen fuit Grisemonken, monachorum ordinis Ciftert.
Oldenkloester, prope Dammonam, Feldvvert olim dictam, monial.ord. Bened.
Then Horn, fororum de tertia Reg. Francisci.
Groninga, domus alia fororum de cad. Reg.
Groninga, domus alia fororü de otd.Wilkensi.

page.notes: The page number "198" at the top left is partly obscured and read with doubt. The running head is not repeated: the title block at the top is the heading of the list. "Oldenkloester" and "Nyenkloester" are read from the long-s forms. "Feldvvert" and the "Groninga" entries are italic in the scan. The catchword "Beth-" is in italic at the lower right.
